title: All about Corinne (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
Corinne Maclou is a background actor. She dreams of one day being more than an extra and stays confident that her breakthrough is right around the corner. When she meets famous actress Sandrine Kiberlain, whom she befriends, Corinne hopes to achieve her goal. But will she
be welcomed into the respectable family of French cinema?

synopsis_lang.en:
Corinne Maclou is a background actor. She dreams of one day being more than an extra and stays confident that her breakthrough is right around the corner. When she meets famous actress Sandrine Kiberlain, whom she befriends, Corinne hopes to achieve her goal. But will she
be welcomed into the respectable family of French cinema?
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Corinne Maclou是一名臨時演員。她夢想有朝一日不再只是臨時演員，並始終相信自己很快就能出頭。後來她認識著名女演員Sandrine Kiberlain並與她成為朋友，Corinne希望藉此出人頭地，但她能否真的能被法國電影界這個令人尊敬的大家庭接納呢?

cast: Isabelle Huppert, Sandrine Kiberlain, Anne Marivin, Emmanuelle Bercot
